<entry id="A00200">
<head-word>אָבַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (√אב, v. 
<xref rid="A00024">אבב</xref>; cmp. גבר, חבר) 
<italic>to be bent, pressed, thick</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִבֵּר, אִיבֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strengthen, harden</italic> (cmp. אמץ).</definition>
<notes> Snh. 109
<sup>b</sup> (play on 
<italic>Abiram</italic>, Num. XVI, 1) שאִי' לבו מ' וכ' Ms. M. (Rashi לבבו, ed. עצמו) he hardened his heart against repentance.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of אֵבֶר) 
<italic>to measure wings, to define city limits, for Sabbath distances, in cases of wing-like projections beyond the line</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. V, 1 כיצד מְאַבְּרִין (accord. to Rab’s spelling, while Sam. read מְעַבְּרִין, v. Y. ib. 22
<sup>b</sup>, Bab. ib. 53
<sup>a</sup>) how do we measure outskirts of a city in order to draw the Sabbath line?; v. etymol. definit. Y. a. Babl. ll. cc. a. Y. Ber. VII, 12
<sup>c </sup>top.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (b. h. Hif.) 
<italic>to soar, take wings</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 42 (play on 
<italic>Shemeber</italic>, Gen. XIV, 2) שמְאַבֵּר וכ' Ar. s. v. שמאבר (ed. שהיה פורח) he took wings to fly and obtain wealth.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<notes> Targ. Job XXXIX, 29.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A00202">

<senses>
<sense>

<xref rid="A00199">אָבַר</xref>; cmp. כַּף,
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> כָּנָף)</xref></language-reference></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>limb</italic>, 
<italic>part</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—א' מן החי a part cut off from a living animal. Ḥull. 101
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>membrum genitale</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 107
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Keth. V, 30
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>town quarter, projecting outskirts</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="A00199">אָבַר</xref>
<italic>Pi</italic>.</definition>
<notes> 2).—א' א' 
<italic>limb by limb; piecemeal</italic>. Sabb. 40
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Yoma VI, 43
<sup>d</sup> bot. Koh. R. to X, 15.—
<plural-form>Pl. אֵבָרִים, אֵיבָרִים, אֵיבָרִין</plural-form>
<italic>limbs, parts</italic> (of an animal). Shek. VII, 3 meat found אי' in entire limbs (opp. חתיכות cut slices). Sabb. 82
<sup>b</sup> אינה מטמאה לא' Ms. M. (ed. לא' אינה) does not make unclean when dismembered. Kel. XVIII, 9 (parts of a bedstead).—א' א' as sing. Ḥull. 11
<sup>b</sup>. Treat. S’maḥ. II, 12.—Ber. I, 1 the fat וא' and other pieces of the daily offerings. Ohol. I, 8 רמ"ח א' 248 limbs (joints).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>balance of a load, ballast</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 154
<sup>b</sup>, v. חֶבֶר.—Ch. אֵיבְרָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A00203">
<head-word>אֲבָר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>

<xref rid="A00199">אָבַר</xref>;
<language-key> b. h. </language-key>

<xref rid="unknown">עֹפֶרֶת</xref>)</language-reference>
<italic>lead</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 52
<sup>a</sup> פתילה של א' a string (bar) of lead. Ḥull. 8

<sup>a</sup>; Sabb. 104
<sup>b</sup> כתבו בא' if he wrote the document with lead (solution); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A00235">
<head-word>אַגַּב</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (contr. of אל גב = עַל, cmp. אַ־) prop. 
<italic>on the back, on top of</italic>, hence, 
<italic>upon, on the basis;</italic> (logic.) 
<italic>by dint of, on account of; by the way of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 95
<sup>b</sup> א' אורחך while on thy road, i.e. 
<italic>incidentally, occasionally</italic>. Freq. אורחא א', v. אוֹרְחָא.—B. Mets. 21
<sup>b</sup> א' דיקירי 
<italic>because</italic> they are heavy.—Ib. 11
